notes.title: Sail Forth is out now!
notes.notes:
We're so excited to announce that Sail Forth is OUT NOW on Steam!

Master semi-realistic sailing physics to chart unknown waters in a heartfelt journey to save the world! Put the wind to your back and cast out into a vast ocean spanning dozens of eccentric regions. Discover countless isles bursting with their own flora, fauna, friendly folk, and fearsome foes. Playfully pursue a pod of curious dolphins, admire the beauty of the sun sinking into an icy horizon, or run down a clutch of cowardly criminals only to accept their apologies to the tune of wild cannonry. Will you answer the call of High Adventure?

Get it for 10% off now through December 28!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031460/Sail_Forth/

notes.title: Our new game Freshly Frosted is out now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm really excited to let you all know that the game I've been working on for the past 3 years is out now on Steam! It's called Freshly Frosted, and it's an adorable puzzle game that takes place in a donut factory in the sky. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5664384/710c68ce47c55e071f80bd93b4b1ebee04d428b8.gif[/img]

Freshly Frosted started as a game jam game in 2019 on Train Jam and since then I, along with Ally O Taylor and Amanda End, have been working on it in our free time to build levels, polish the art, and make it a fun and chill play experience. 

If you know me, you know I love making puzzle games. I've poured a lot of love into the 144 puzzles in Freshly Frosted and I hope you take the time to check it out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070790/Freshly_Frosted/

-Ty

notes.title: KUR IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]KUR is available right now for everyone to play.[/b]

Thanks to everyone who has followed all our development updates, showcase appearances, streams, and demo events - KUR is out now and ready for all of you to play. We've got a long list of things we'd love for you all to experience across all 23 levels, a huge arsenal of weapons, and the hordes of robotic flesh-wearing enemies. 

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1706288137437804250/94B6FF1EE566EE376CACD95155DA2FD2B8A6978C/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

We've released KUR as an Early Access title in order to give Really Ragdoll more time to polish the game and work with the community to implement changes. The game is content complete with over 20 levels, and we're looking forward to making the game the best it can be along with all of your help.

This comedic take on the classic ‘90s shooter lets you put the boot to your enemies - literally - you can slide and kick your way out of most situations, and if that doesn't get your totally real human blood pumping there's always the shrink ray that lets you shrink enemies and punt them into gloriously gibby explosions of limbs and microchips. Fight drones, spider robots made out of the skulls of their victims, mutated giants with nuclear waste barrel hammers, and even more! We’re pretty sure you fight a sentient meatball that is also a train conductor at one point. Each level is filled with pure WTF moments and excellent classic fps gameplay all to the beat of a pulse-pounding electronic rock soundtrack. Embrace the early ‘90s and not-quite-old-school gaming tropes all while upgrading yourself to be the best, most badass, space mercenary you can be.

[b]Now, buy the s***ting game already![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1243520/KUR/

notes.title: Why did you get Tumblestone from the Humble Bundle?
notes.notes:
EDIT April 8, 2017:
If you purchased both the Yogscast charity bundle in January and the Humble Monthly Bundle in April, you might be in a situation where you are not able to activate your Humble Monthly Bundle key for the full version of Tumblestone, because Steam thinks that you already have the game. If that's the case, this forum post applies to you, and you will need to follow the steps detailed in this post before activating your new key for the full game of Tumblestone that you got from the Humble Monthly. Sorry again for any inconvenience here - the fact that your new key would not "just work" was a sad surprise to us, and we want ot help you get that fixed if this applies to you.

---

You may have noticed Tumblestone in your Steam library after purchasing the Humble Yogscast Bungle. First of all, thank you for supporting some great charities with the 100%-to-charity Humble Bundle!

You've received 60 games for a very low price of $30. Most of these great games are older than Tumblestone, and because of that are now ready to be included in a bundle. An example is our previous game, The Bridge, which released over three years ago and is now included in some bundles such as this. Tumblestone, however, released fairly recently, and we're still working to tell new players about it. This is why we included a trial of Tumblestone along with The Bridge, but only in this bundle.

To be clear, you did not pay for the Tumblestone Trial as a part of the Humble Bundle. Tumblestone was not one of the 60 games that you received for $30 - The Bridge was, and you've received a full copy of The Bridge. The Tumblestone Trial is simply a bonus that you've received along with The Bridge. You've received with the Tumblestone Trial was more than what was advertised in the Humble Bundle - it was an extra.

Even though it is a Tumblestone "Trial", you're given 30 full levels to play and the ability to play the award-winning online multiplayer for free, with no obligation to pay anything for the rest of the game.

We understand that some of you are confused by this. This was not a scheme by a malicious developer - we are a very small four-man, self-funded, bootstrapping team. In fact, we did not make a cent off of this bundle - all of the money has gone to charity. We were simply trying to spread the word about our new game Tumblestone while giving players all of the features included in the trial. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience if you did not wish to have Tumblestone in your library.

EDIT January 6, 2017:
[I've posted these notes in the comments here, but for convenience I'll write this in this main post.]

Even though it may be a Tumblestone "Trial", we hope that you'll give it a try as you might like it. Still, if you want to remove the game, you can follow these steps: With both The Bridge and Tumblestone uninstalled:
* Click "Support"
* Click "Games, Software, etc"
* Find the game
* Click "I want to permanently remove this game from my account"

If this is requiring you to uninstall The Bridge also, you'll need to, but you can then email me at ty@quantumastrophysics.com and I'll send you a key for just The Bridge. This isn't ideal by any means, and I apologize for this unforeseen inconvenience if you want The Bridge in your library but not Tumblestone.

notes.title: Free Tumblestone Trial Now Available!
notes.notes: We've added the ability for you to try Tumblestone for free! You can play the trial by selecting green button that says "Play Game", just above the option to buy the full game. The trial includes the first ten levels of the story mode, one minute rounds of each arcade mode, and the ability to play multiplayer for up to five games per day. Enjoy!

notes.title: About the Multiplayer Starter Pack
notes.notes:
[b]What version is right for me? Or, what's up with the DLC?[/b]
A number of people have been asking about the DLC and the different versions of Tumblestone, so we wanted to put this FAQ together to answer your questions.

[b]Which version of the game is right for me?[/b]
If you are only interested in multiplayer then the "Multiplayer Starter Pack" is the right choice. On the other hand if you want to play the 3 arcade modes or 40+ hour story mode you want "Tumblestone" -- the full game. You can always upgrade from the Multiplayer Starter Pack to the full game for the price difference.

[b]Why is there DLC at all?[/b]
We wanted to offer the "Multiplayer Starter Pack" for players who are only interested in the multiplayer features of Tumblestone. Due to how Steam works we needed to use DLC to make that possible.

[b]Can I upgrade from the Multiplayer Starter Pack to the full game?[/b]
You can upgrade at any point for the difference in the price.
